text:
anna: Heads-up — noticed a sharp console perf regression after yesterday's routing-weight rollout (commit bb3f7a). Heatmap/sparklines P95 chart-render jumped from ~120ms -> ~540ms in eu-west canary. Anyone else seeing this?

deploy-bot: deploy bb3f7a to canary-eu completed 2026-03-20T22:12Z :white_check_mark:

sam: yup, seeing same in grafana. Also noticed client bundle for charts chunk increased — sourcemap shows charting.chunk.js 1.2MB -> 2.9MB after the splitpoint reorder.

mike: I grabbed a trace — lots of long tasks during initial paint, main thread blocked parsing a large chunk. Quick excerpt from lighthouse trace: ```
LongTask (200ms) at charting.chunk.js: parse/compile
Task 1: 230ms
Task 2: 180ms
Total scripting: ~520ms
```

sam: toggling prefetch off in the canary (client feature flag) made a big diff locally — p95 dropped to ~150ms. So prefetch + new chunk ordering might be thrashing the cache.

infra-bot: KV cache eviction rate spiked from 3% -> 74% after routing-weight change in eu-west between 22:12-22:30Z. Correlated with increased client requests for missing prefetched payloads.

jen: thoughts: rollback routing-weight quickly or flip prefetch=off for canary while we triage? We should avoid full rollback if we can mitigate.

anna: prefer prefetch toggle for now so we don't affect other regions. Can ops flip prefetch flag for canary-eu?

mike: +1. Also need to revert the splitpoint reorder in the bundler; that change combined two large modules into charting chunk. That explains size jump. I'll open a PR to split them back.

sam: opened quick repro script: ```bash
# hit metric endpoint for canary
curl -s "https://internal-metrics/realtime?service=console&region=eu-west&canary=true" | jq '.charts.render_p95, .bundle.size'
# returns
540
2900000
```

deploy-bot: feature flag prefetch=off applied to canary-eu at 2026-03-20T22:38Z by ops-team :hammer_and_wrench:

anna: after prefetch off — metrics improving. p95 now ~160ms and KV eviction back down to ~6%. Leave canary running for 30m, mike proceed with PR to split chunk.

mike: filing PR now, will include a build size diff and sourcemap evidence.

jen: add a console alert for bundle-size > 1.8MB on critical chunks so we catch this earlier.

sam: noted. I'll own the alert and add a dashboard widget showing chunk sizes + KV eviction trend.

anna: sweet. Thanks y'all. Follow up: postmortem with timeline and the canary flag decision after we merge the PR. :eyes:
